author: OpenAI Codex
purpose: Evaluate dictionary-style retrieval and source-layer discipline on two user-supplied questions.

corpus.coverage_note: Every PDF page has an index row, but 631 fragmented, low-text or empty pages remain OCR candidates. A zero-hit result therefore means no evidence in the current text index, not proof that no unreadable page can contain it.

source_policy.book_facts: Only claims supported by cited PDF pages.
source_policy.taiwan_names: TaiCOL first; Tai2 or another Taiwan public authority second. Preserve the scientific name when no verified Taiwan Chinese name is available.
source_policy.web_supplement: Current medical guidance and cultural associations are labelled external and never presented as book content.

questions.question_zh_tw: 便秘的時候有什麼植物可以用？具有什麼處理方法？

book_candidates.book_processing_summary: The leaves were given almost exclusively as an infusion. The entry also lists fluid extract, syrup, compound infusion, tincture and confection preparations.
book_candidates.book_effect_and_risk_summary: The entry describes a mild laxative effect but also abdominal pain, nausea and even colic in many people.

book_candidates.display_name_zh_tw: Rhamnus purshiana（未查得台灣公開中文名，保留學名）
book_candidates.book_processing_summary: The bark was not used fresh; the entry says it was stored for more than a year. It describes maceration with magnesium oxide and water, drying, and preparation as fluid extract, tincture or wine.
book_candidates.book_effect_and_risk_summary: The entry connects the aged bark with habitual constipation and says fresh bark could cause nausea and colic.

book_candidates.taiwan_name_status: Tai2 Non-Taiwanese record without Chinese name
book_candidates.book_processing_summary: The rhizome was treated with alcohol; the resin called podophyllin was precipitated from the alcoholic solution with acidified water or alum.
book_candidates.book_effect_and_risk_summary: The entry calls the root and resin drastic purgatives and notes colic. It is not suitable as a modern self-treatment instruction.

book_candidates.book_scientific_name: Aloe socotrina (succotrina) Lam. and other Aloe source species
book_candidates.taiwan_name_status: generic Chinese name only; exact source-species mapping not promoted
book_candidates.book_processing_summary: The drug is described in powder, pills and tincture among other preparations.
book_candidates.book_effect_and_risk_summary: The entry links it to habitual constipation but says larger doses are drastic and frequent or prolonged use is very harmful.

book_candidates.book_processing_summary: The medicinal product discussed is expressed castor oil, not eating the seeds.
book_candidates.book_effect_and_risk_summary: The entry describes occasional use of castor oil for constipation. Taiwan public sources warn that the seeds contain ricin and can poison when eaten.

book_candidates.current_scientific_name: source species unresolved in the book entry
book_candidates.book_processing_summary: The entry lists substance, infusion, powder and pill forms.
book_candidates.book_effect_and_risk_summary: The effect depends on dose, and the entry says it is not recommended as a permanent laxative.

false_positive_and_safety_checks.reason: The constipation sentence refers to another similarly named resin, not Hydrastis itself.
The same page labels the plant poisonous despite reporting historical use for obstipation.

current_external_layer.preferred_first_response: Begin with dietary fibre, enough fluid when increasing fibre, regular physical activity and appropriate bowel habits. A fibre product such as psyllium may be considered according to its label and a clinician or pharmacist. Senna is a short-term stimulant laxative, not a long-term daily herb.
current_external_layer.medical_boundary: Seek medical advice if self-care fails or constipation is persistent; rectal bleeding, blood in stool or continual abdominal pain are reasons to see a doctor.

evaluation.reason: The index retrieves several real entries and preparation details, while the safety checker removes toxic or misleading candidates and prevents historical formulations from becoming unsupervised modern instructions.

questions.question_zh_tw: 天秤座相關的植物有哪些？
questions.strict_book_answer: 現有四冊文字索引查不到天秤座、黃道、星座或金星與任何植物的關聯，因此不能依這本書指定『天秤座植物』。

related_book_entries.name: Rosa gallica / Rosa centifolia / Rosa damascena
related_book_entries.relation_note: The book has a rose entry, but the pages do not connect roses to Libra.

web_cultural_supplement.answer: 占星文化網站常把玫瑰與天秤座連結；部分來源也列水仙。這是文化聯想，不是植物學或醫學結論，而且不同網站的配對並不一致。

evaluation.reason: A chatbot claiming the rose-Libra link comes from the book would be hallucinating.

overall_verdict: The dictionary-first retrieval is already useful for grounded text questions. The required answer contract is book evidence first, Taiwan display-name resolution second, optional web supplement third, with explicit refusal when a relation is absent from the book.
